tagline: Socratic Debate Analysis & Fallacy Detection Engine
brief: A precision cognitive instrument that analyzes spoken dialectic in real time, detecting logical fallacies and formulating surgical Socratic cross-examinations. The identity blends ancient Greek dialectic rigor with high-tech obsidian CNC hardware precision.
criteria: Success: Immediately recognisable lowercase Greek epsilon (ἔ) with polytonic diacritics, 45-degree CNC-milled instrument facets, ultra-crisp at 16px, and authoritative on dark obsidian UI.

concepts.name: The Faceted Caliper
concepts.idea: A mirrored-3 lowercase Greek polytonic epsilon (ἔ) formed from 45-degree chamfered precision caliper facets.
rationale: Typographic authenticity: Direct representation of the Greek root ἔλεγχος (elenchus) crowned with smooth breathing (psili) and acute spark (oxia)
Instrumental aesthetic: 45-degree architectural chamfers evoke high-end CNC-milled obsidian hardware, perfectly harmonizing with the dark desktop HUD
Scale resilience: 100/100 audited vector geometry that stays razor-sharp from 16px favicons to high-res display billboards

recommendation: The Faceted Caliper is the definitive visual signature for Elenchus: mathematically precise, historically anchored in Socratic dialectic, and calibrated for dark-mode developer tools.
